paragraphs.text: DKB CBS – QCB regulatory reporting (NBS001, Tables 601–625). Prepared for DKB Finance, 21 October 2026.
Mapping reviewed: NBS001 - Add Tables Mapping (1).xlsx: 26 tables, about 3,900 rule cells (combined sheet plus separate sheets for Tables 612–615 and 625).
Balances: CAL extract (CONSOLIDATE.ASST.LIAB) at 31 Aug 2026, UAT, used to test whether the rules reach the balances that exist. Two records with impossible amounts excluded.
Reference: Customer sector codes as defined by DKB: Retail 1000–1999, 4000–4004, 6000/6001, 7000/7001; Corporate 2000–2003, 2006, 4005, 5001, 5002; Government 2005; Banks & FI 2004.

Caveat. Findings are based on the rules as written. Amounts are indicative UAT figures and show the size of the balances a rule does or does not reach; they are not reconciled report values. Cell and row references refer to the reviewed workbook version.
Credit facilities by maturity (Tables 608/609) map almost none of the actual financing (B1–B4)
About 95bn of financing principal (31 Aug) falls outside the rules; profit balances are reported as loans
Cash reported as claims on banks (D2)
Cash in vault and ATMs (about 115bn at 31 Aug) is selected in the claims-on-banks line of Tables 604/605
Corporate and government financing are excluded from Tables 608/609; definitions differ between NBS001 tables
Same double mapping as found in NBS01, repeated across asset and liability tables
ACCDEFERREDPFT is used on the asset side (netted against RECDEFERREDPFT) and on the liability side
Assets: 608/609 "01 Loans", 616/618/621/622 "03 Others", 613 "01 Other Assets". Liabilities: 623/624 "01 Deferred Interest / Income"
About 14.7bn (31 Aug) used twice; assets understated
Remove ACCDEFERREDPFT from the asset lines; keep it in deferred interest / income
Nostro category 5001 is selected in two lines
Nostro balances (5001) counted in both bank types
Split nostros by bank type (e.g. target 59/60) and select each once
In 608/609 the "01 Loans" line selects categories 3000–3899, which also covers the Ijara categories used in "04 Finance Ijara" without a balance-type filter
Ijara profit balances can be counted twice
Islamic finance lines select categories that hold no balances; the actual financing categories are not mapped
Murabaha – Musawama: 3716; Istisna'a: 3712; Mudaraba: 3711; Diminishing Musharaka: 3707; "06 Others": no rule
About 95.5bn of principal (31 Aug) in 3701, 3704, 3709, 3713, 3715, 3717, 3730, 3740 and others is not reported; only Ijara (3702, 3706, about 4.2bn) is reached
Map the actual product categories to the lines (as agreed for NBS01 Table 8) and fill "06 Others" with the remaining range
"01 Loans" uses the accrued-income balance types
608/609 rows "01 Loans": ACC/REC DEFERREDPFT, DUE/GRC/NAB PRINCIPALPFT, categories 3000–3899
Remove the profit types; leave the line empty unless DKB has conventional loans
Islamic finance lines have no balance-type filter
608/609 Islamic finance rows (CATEGORY and SECTOR only)
All balance types can be picked up, including profit, fees and commitments
Apply the seven principal types (CUR, GRC, DUE, PDO, NAB, DEL, PRE ACCOUNT), as in Tables 613 and 614
Map overdrawn current accounts (DEBIT on the overdraft categories)
Sector sections in 608/609 do not match DKB sector codes
Retail reported as public sector; corporate (2000–2003, about 27.8bn), government (2005, about 21.2bn) and other sectors (about 6.4bn) excluded (31 Aug principal)
Public = 2005; Non-bank FI = 2004 (excluding banks); Private = all other customer sectors
Sector definitions differ between NBS001 tables

610/611, 617, 619, 623/624: 2004 / 2005 / all other (consistent with DKB codes). 616, 618, 621, 622: explicit list omitting 5002. 612: government by targets 55–57. 614: list omits 4000–4004, 2005, 2006, 5001, 5002
Same customer reported in different sectors depending on the table
Use one sector definition across all NBS001 tables
D. Claims on central banks and banks (Tables 604/605)
No balances in 5003/5004 at 31 Aug; the QCB reserve sits in 18060/18061 (already changed in the NBS01 tables)
The claims-on-banks line selects cash categories
Cash in vault and ATMs (about 114.7bn at 31 Aug) reported as claims on banks
Remove cash categories; select nostro and placement categories only
Deposit balance types include a non-existent type and miss matured deposits
CURBALANCE does not exist in CAL; PAYACCOUNT (about 340m at 31 Aug) not selected
Credit / deposit ratio table is incomplete
625: rules only for deposits, wakala placements and borrowings
Credit side of the ratio not mapped
Map the credit facility side, consistent with Tables 608/609
Derivative contracts table has no rules
Map derivatives (source to be confirmed, e.g. Treasury)
Many description lines have no rule
Unclear whether lines are intentionally zero or missing
Treasury tables read TMS outbound tables
Same source gap as seen in NBS01 (Treasury Bills)
Reconcile outbound tables to the trial balance for each run
Where principal balance types are listed (Tables 613, 614, 615 and parts of the combined sheet), all seven types are used, including DEL and PRE.
Several tables already use the DKB sector split correctly (610/611, 617, 619, 623/624); they can serve as the template for C1 and C2.
DKB Finance to confirm the sector definition (C1, C2) and the product-to-line assignment for credit facilities (B1).
SL to correct Tables 604/605 and 608/609 first (priorities 1–3), then A1, E1–E3.
Rerun NBS001 and reconcile the credit facilities, deposits and claims-on-banks tables to the NBS01 tables and the trial balance at the same date.
